outcome_summary: Fixed two root-cause bugs in the orchestrator's Deep Agents subagent path: (1) injected PathNormalizationMiddleware into each subagent spec dict via setdefault/append so subagents receive the same virtual-path rewriting as the main agent, eliminating doubled directory structures; (2) added _maybe_rename_plan_dir() to cli.py, executing a pre-lock plan-folder date rename so all downstream state is initialized with the correct path and PM mid-run renames become no-ops. Both changes are covered by 11 new tests (8 passing immediately on fresh suite: 1,122 pass, 3 pre-existing failures unchanged), documented in Constraint §26/§27, and released as orchestrator v1.4.0.
